subject: Isekai Realms Beta 1: the world wakes up
summary: The world is bigger, its creatures think for themselves, and something very old now sleeps under a black mountain in the east.

items.head: The Wyrm.
items.text: One dragon in all the world, asleep in a cave under the Wyrmcrown. No blade can mark it until the endgame. Wake it and it chases you off the mountain, breathing fire, and it remembers you.

items.head: A bigger world.
items.text: 10 by 10 lands, up from 8 by 8, with the drowned Mirefen in the south and two new villages.

items.head: Ten new creatures.
items.text: Deer, boars, crabs, bats, bandits, skeleton archers, cave spiders, mountain trolls and ashen wraiths, with shoals of fish in the water.

items.head: A bestiary.
items.text: The journal has an entry for every creature, unlocked the first time you get a good look at it.

items.head: More to do.
items.text: Five new guild quests, a longer board as your rank rises, more favors, and a final hunt the King offers once you are Oathbound.

items.head: Spawning like Minecraft.
items.text: Packs by biome and by light, caves with their own monsters, and lanterns that truly keep the dark things away. Nothing appears where you are looking.

items.head: Despawning that makes sense.
items.text: Creatures leave when they are far off and idle, never in front of you. Named foes track you down again.

items.head: Real pathfinding.
items.text: A shared flow field for the hunt and A* for errands, so creatures go round walls and through doors.

items.head: Smarter by nature.
items.text: Wolves encircle you, goblins run when hurt, skeletons keep their range, spiders pounce, deer bolt as a herd and guards call for help.

items.head: Grand town buildings.
items.text: The guild hall, smithy, hospital, inn, church and keep are rebuilt from the ground up, with real interiors.

items.head: Empty shops.
items.text: Blacksmiths, guild masters and doctors now keep their posts day and night, even in the middle of a big city.

items.head: Wall hopping.
items.text: Characters only jump at a one-block step, not at every wall they meet.

items.head: Lost events.
items.text: Raids, caravans and the law wait for somewhere to stand instead of quietly failing.

items.head: Not played yet.
items.text: This build has not been run through the automated tests or played in a browser, so expect rough edges, especially in the new art and the dragon fight. Old saves upgrade themselves, but the far east and south coasts will change shape.

pictures.caption: The Wyrm, with an adventurer for scale.
